headline: Loans, Overseas Business and Wealth Management All Fire Together; Changhua Bank EPS NT$1.12 for First 7 Months - Liberty Finance
summary: Changhua Bank reported cumulative first-half consolidated after-tax profit of NT$11.314 billion, up nearly 24% year on year. First-half EPS of NT$0.94 also set a record, with loans, overseas business and wealth management contributing.
why: Changhua Bank is a major Taiwanese lender listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange. Its earnings and loan growth reflect the health of Taiwan's banking sector and domestic credit demand.
